title: laight workflow
description: One self-contained laight workflow: its seats (the agents) and its steps. See CLAUDE.md, section 3.

id.description: Workflow id; `laight run <id>`. Should match the file name.

summary.description: One line on what the workflow does. May use templates.

base.description: Branch worktrees start from and PRs go into. Default: main.

env.description: Environment for every seat and shell step.

seats.description: The rig: exactly these agents are started for a run.

max_hops.description: Step starts allowed in one run (matrix copies count). Default 50.

step.description: A step over this raises an inbox item (it is not killed).

on_finish.description: What happens to the run's worktrees when it ends. The tmux session always stops.

ident.description: Lower case letters, digits, '-' and '_', starting with a letter.

duration.description: A Go duration such as 90m, 1h30m or 45s.

uses.description: A shared seat file, relative to .laight/ (e.g. seats/reviewer.yaml). Fields here override it.

command.description: For runtime shell: the command to run in the pane.

cwd.description: worktree (own per run, default) | repo (the main checkout) | a path.

session.description: fresh restarts the CLI before each step. Default resume.

permissions.description: Default: default (every permission prompt goes to the inbox).

guidance.description: A Markdown file, relative to .laight/, appended to the agent's system prompt.

setup.description: Shell command run once in a new worktree before the agent starts.

mode.description: End the branch after this step, whatever the exit.

type.description: Default: agent if `seat` is set, shell if `run` is set.

seat.description: agent steps: the seat that does the step.

objective.description: agent steps: the prompt, a Go template.

run.description: shell steps: the command, a Go template. Exit 0 → ok, else failed.

exits.description: shell steps: exit code → exit name.

ask.description: gate steps: the question for the human.

allowed_exits.description: Default: [handoff] for agent, [yes, no] for gate, [ok] for shell. `failed` is always allowed.

needs.description: Start when all these steps have finished without failing. Such a step can't be a route target.

matrix.description: One copy of the step per combination. Values: a list, or a template rendering a JSON list.

max_parallel.description: Matrix copies alive at once. Default 4.
